name: intent
description: Semantic color intent. 'primary' for general information, 'success' for a completed action, 'warning' for something that needs attention, 'danger' for an error or a failed action. 'secondary' and 'neutral' are for low-emphasis notes. Default: 'primary'.

name: variant
description: Visual emphasis. 'weak' (tinted background and border) suits most alerts. 'outline' (border only) is quieter, for alerts that sit among other content. 'solid' (filled background) is the strongest; keep it for the one message on the screen that must not be missed. Default: 'weak'.

name: rounded
description: Corner radius (small, medium, large). In the game theme the pixel frame's corners are stepped instead. Default: 'medium'.

name: title
description: Short summary shown in bold above the description, such as "Couldn't save changes".

name: children
description: Description: what happened and what the user can do about it.

name: icon
description: Icon shown before the text. Defaults to an icon that matches `intent`. Pass your own element to replace it, or `false` to show no icon. Custom icons should be decorative (`aria-hidden`), since the text carries the message.

name: action
description: Actions shown below the text, such as a "Retry" button or a link.

name: onClose
description: Shows a dismiss button and is called when it is pressed. The Alert doesn't hide itself: remove it in this callback, and move focus to a sensible element (for example the control that the alert was about), since the focused button disappears with it.

name: closeLabel
description: Accessible name of the dismiss button. Default: 'Dismiss'.
